text: At its meeting on November 7, 8 and 9, 2017, City Council adopted Item TE27.5 regarding the proposed Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendments for 295-349 George Street to permit the George Street Revitalisation project. The George Street Revitalisation project entails the demolition of the existing Seaton House and its replacement with a new 9-storey institutional building. In Part 2 of its decision, City Council directed the City Solicitor to request the Ontario Municipal Board to modify Official Plan Amendment 82 for the lands at 295-349 George Street substantially in accordance with Attachment 7 to the report (September 19, 2017) from the Director, Community Planning, Toronto and East York.
